title: 十四樓冇燈
mood: quietly surprised by your own building
subject: fourteen days of stairs while the lift is being repaired
caption: Cantonese bedroom folktronica. An acoustic guitar figure chopped and granulated so it stutters and re-pitches, a granular synth pad built from the same guitar, soft rounded kick and finger-tapped percussion, real stairwell field recordings of footsteps and doors used as rhythm, one clean guitar passage left untouched at the end. Lo-fi and grainy with deliberate digital artefacts, the voice dry against it. Soft male voice, close and plain, nearly spoken. 100 BPM, D minor. Quietly surprised by your own building. No drum kit, no four-on-the-floor, no EDM build, no big chorus, no key change.
lyrics:
[Verse]
升降機維修十四日 通告貼咗 冇人睇
我住十四樓 一日兩次 樓梯
第三日我開始數 一層二十二級
第七日我唔數咗 我開始認得人

[Pre-Chorus]
八樓有個婆婆 每次都坐喺樓梯口歇
我每次都問「要唔要幫手」 佢每次都話唔用

[Chorus]
十四樓冇燈 感應燈壞咗 冇人報
黑嘅時候 我靠個轉角嘅聲音認路
好奇怪 呢十四日
我識得我住嗰棟樓 多過之前五年

[Verse]
第十日 我幫婆婆拎米 上到五樓
佢話「你住邊層」 我話十四
佢話「咁你辛苦啲」 然後佢笑
嗰下 我覺得我真係住喺呢度

[Chorus]
十四樓冇燈 感應燈壞咗 我報咗
黑嘅時候 我靠個轉角嘅聲音認路
好奇怪 呢十四日
我識得我住嗰棟樓 多過之前五年

[Outro]
升降機修好咗 我撳十四
我再冇見過八樓
